scope: Executable data preparation from supplied PIONEER ROOT files through mixed and origin-resliced model inputs, with frozen benchmark-table concatenation.
optional_conversion_dependencies: PIONEER ROOT event dictionaries and geometry/runtime environment
portability_changes: Replaced machine-specific data/output/LUT defaults with required CLI arguments and package-relative imports.
PyROOT loaded only inside converter operations; safe import and --help without ROOT.
Explicit main functions and guards for all CLIs; no jobs run on import.
Outputs and manifest paths checked before work; successful commands write filenames/sizes/settings/module-hash provenance.
Zero-progress mixing raises an error instead of looping forever when source pools produce no eligible events.
Origin reslicing streams batches while preserving dense sorted origin/slice labels and energy-weighted times; checks aligned ragged-array lengths.
Combination streams selected shards with strict column-set/type preflight and no silently skipped schema mismatches.
Grouped source-pool assembly generalizes the sorted index*files_per_pool slicing rule, default 14 files per pool.
Unmixed wrapper exposes --no_shuffle_files and --keep_untriggered_michel; neither changes the archived default unless selected.
Direct mixer additionally exposes physical pileup rate, calo-only rate, radiative-donor removal, and no-replacement flags already supported by its class.

scientific_behavior_preserved.generator_effective_seed: (CLI seed + sum(ord(c) for c in job_name)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
scientific_behavior_preserved.generator_seed_with_none: uses unseeded NumPy state, preserving original behavior; supply a seed for repeatable new production
scientific_behavior_preserved.no_replace_scope: each generate_batch call only; permutations reset across chunks
scientific_behavior_preserved.root_parallel_event_limit: ceil(max_events/nprocs) per worker; global total may differ from requested max
scientific_behavior_preserved.fast3_status: optional historical transform; not inserted into final fl2 production
scientific_behavior_preserved.standard_benchmark_status: historical four-job recipe, not final fl2; use generate_tail_reveal for final recipe

external_requirements.simulation: G4Pioneer binary, macros/geometry, physics configuration, and ROOT files must be supplied; not generated or bundled by this release.
external_requirements.source_split: Preexisting channel/train-val-eval directories consumed; complete historical source-file split manifest not recovered.
external_requirements.historical_inputs: Only first 20 final Michel mixed-input tasks retained by original launcher; regenerated samples require exact source pools, seeds, chunk sizes and code snapshot.
external_requirements.cross_model_joins: Source event IDs alone are not globally unique across source files and mixing realizations; validate shard/row identity explicitly.
